verdict: Yes. Patil Kaki from Mumbai pitched homemade Maharashtrian snacks on Shark Tank India Season 2 and got a deal. Buyers pay for the taste of home cooking, especially festival snacks and regional specialities, but keeping homemade taste consistent at scale is the challenge.
angle: Regional snacks such as chakli, ladoo, chivda and modak have loyal buyers across India and abroad. Festivals bring huge demand. A team of home cooks trained to standard recipes, plus FSSAI compliance, lets you scale while keeping the homemade feel.
